name: jp-form-builder
description: JayPee Solutions Form Builder is a WordPress plugin to create basic forms like a contact form.
author: Jan-Peter Alten <support@jaypee.solutions>

scripts.i18n:pot: WP_ENV_HOME=./.wp-env npx --no-install wp-env run cli --env-cwd=wp-content/plugins/$(basename "$PWD") wp i18n make-pot . languages/jp-form-builder.pot --domain=jp-form-builder --exclude=src,vendor,node_modules,tests,build,.wp-env
scripts.i18n:json: WP_ENV_HOME=./.wp-env npx --no-install wp-env run cli --env-cwd=wp-content/plugins/$(basename "$PWD") wp i18n make-json languages --no-purge
